name: erp:integrate
description: Gate IAM-10 (ADR-0014 §111): grants permission to call baobab-erp's own application-service integration boundary (/context/resolve*, /mapping/resolve*), whose HTTP endpoints previously trusted network location alone. Distinct from context:resolve, whose aud=baobab-control-plane mapper is for baobab-cp, not baobab-erp -- a token scoped for the Control Plane SHALL NOT also work against ERP (ADR-0007 §§24-25).
